description: This PHP source file defines a class ConfiguratorViewEdit extending ViewEdit, used for rendering and processing the configuration editing interface in SuiteCRM's admin module. It handles permissions, loads settings, and renders a configuration form.

classes.name: ConfiguratorViewEdit
classes.description: A view class for editing configuration settings within SuiteCRM's administration module.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Checks if the current user is an admin before displaying the view.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Generates the module title parameters with a link to the Admin index.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Handles errors during processing and calls parent process method.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Loads settings, checks for form restore, assigns variables to the template, and renders the edit view.

methods.name: checkGoogleSyncJSON
methods.description: Decodes and verifies Google authentication JSON, sets template variables based on its validity.
